path.label: About me
path.title: How I got here.
path.1.title: It started with servers.
path.1.text: I studied systems administration on the island where I grew up, taking machines and networks apart to see how they work.
path.2.title: Then I wrote the software.
path.2.text: Java and Spring Boot backends for clients, among them a national program built on more than 25 microservices.
path.3.title: Now I build where it runs.
path.3.text: I moved our product onto Kubernetes on AWS, defined it in Terraform and made observability my own.
path.4.title: And I make tools.
path.4.text: Small utilities, guides and AI helpers that save my team time. Most of what I enjoy building starts here.
path.5.title: Next: things of my own.
path.5.text: From November I live in Italy, building products, tools and platforms, and working remotely.
